description: Run only the anti-RE hardening rules (VGL-ARE-*): release minification, debug signing, debuggable builds, backup and cleartext settings, plist transport exceptions, release obfuscation, Electron/Node isolation, inspector flags and production source maps. Reports hardening gaps, not vulnerabilities. Optionally narrow the review to one platform. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was scanned. Returns a text summary grouped by platform and the scan result as structuredContent. Writes local scan history, never source files.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

noBaseline.description: Ignore the baseline and report suppressed findings as active.

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

path.description: Mobile or desktop project to review. Defaults to the server's project root.

platform.description: Only report findings for this platform. Defaults to all.

name: vigil_hardening
title: Review anti-reverse-engineering hardening
